values.messages.display001:
Linear memory, copies, and view lifetime

This sandbox blocks Wasm compilation. The controls below exercise real WebAssembly.Memory with JavaScript computations. For actual JS↔Wasm calls and cold/warm measurements, use the complete standalone files shown below. No sandbox policy changes are required.

Standalone kernel.wat + benchmark.mjs and run instructions
Install the official WABT wat2wasm CLI and Node 22+. Save the two sources into an empty experiment folder. Run: wat2wasm kernel.wat -o kernel.wasm, then node benchmark.mjs. These files are also provided in this lesson source folder.
